about.title: Arabic-first apps, engineered end to end.
about.p1: I'm Moad Almshirem, a software engineer based in Libya. I ship cross-platform mobile apps in Flutter (Riverpod, go_router, dio, Hive) and web apps in React, TypeScript and Next.js — usually owning the API and data layer too, from REST endpoints to SQL schemas and Firebase.
about.p2: Most of what I ship is Arabic-first and bilingual: RTL layouts, Arabic typography, i18n and locale-aware formatting are part of the architecture from day one, not patched in later.

focus.mobile: Flutter with clean architecture, Riverpod state management and offline-first caching
focus.web: React, TypeScript and Next.js with type-safe data flow and smooth motion
focus.backend: REST APIs, Firebase and relational SQL schemas
focus.i18n: Arabic / English i18n with full RTL support
